name: prompt-marks
description: Marks your prompts in the transcript with a colored bar and tinted row, and jumps between them with Option+Up and Option+Down

enabled.title: Prompt Marks: Enabled
enabled.description: Turns all of Prompt Marks on or off

styling.title: Prompt Marks: Styling
styling.description: Draws the accent bar and tinted row behind each prompt

navigation.title: Prompt Marks: Navigation
navigation.description: Jumps between prompts with Option or Ctrl plus Up and Down

accent_color.title: Prompt Marks: Accent color
accent_color.description: Color of the bar left of each prompt; the row tint is mixed from it. One of Purple, Indigo, Blue, Teal, Green, Olive, Amber, Orange, Red, Pink, Slate, or Custom to use the custom hex color.

custom_color.title: Prompt Marks: Custom color
custom_color.description: Hex color such as #5b2a86, used when Accent color is Custom

tint_strength.title: Prompt Marks: Tint strength
tint_strength.description: Percent of the accent color mixed into the terminal background behind each prompt
